limitations.note: The fix correctly registers reads, but the added address guard holds the previous output on an enabled out-of-range read, whereas the reference returns an unknown value.
The out-of-range test hard-coded the agent's hold-last-value assumption, so it passed the behavioral change rather than exposing it.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach

limitations.quote: The FIFO uses a dual-port RAM for data storage
limitations.note: The knowledge-base search surfaced FIFO material but supplied no guidance that the agent used to diagnose or fix this RAM's read behavior.
